title: readonlygit.bats's fixture commits start git's background maintenance, whose repack can land under .git inside an arm's check, so CI's Ubuntu job failed the --version and doctor arms (run 40291928610)
body:
CI's Ubuntu job is red on main at c4f52b8e (run 40291928610, Test on Ubuntu, Run tests), on these arms of tests/unit/readonlygit.bats and nothing else:

- "--version leaves .git untouched on a stale index" (line 141)
- "doctor leaves .git untouched on a stale index" (line 151)

Each fails `assert_unwritten` with "wrote under .git:", naming a new pack with its .idx and .rev, objects/pack/multi-pack-index, objects/info/packs and info/refs, and the objects/, objects/pack/, objects/info/ and info/ directories that hold them. Shell Script Analysis was green.

## Cause

The writer is git, not devbin. What the arms caught is a repack that writes a multi-pack-index and then runs update-server-info: the shape of the geometric repack git's maintenance runs. It wrote no packed-refs and no commit-graph, so it was not git gc. Nothing in devbin's lib, tests or CI runs a repack, gc or maintenance. Under GIT_TRACE in the same fixture on rhadamanth (git 2.56.0), `bin/devbin --version` runs only `git rev-parse --local-env-vars`, `git rev-parse HEAD` and `git status --porcelain`, and `doctor` runs only `git check-attr` and `git rev-parse --local-env-vars`. Neither writes under .git (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/ci/maint-exp3.out).

The fixture's own `git commit` starts `git maintenance run --auto --quiet --detach`, which runs on in the background after the commit returns (traced under git 2.54.0 and 2.56.0, ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/ci/maint-exp.out). It is the only process in these arms that can repack. When its repack writes after stale() has backdated .git, the arm reads git's write as devbin's. The two arms that failed build their fixture with gitproj, which commits a whole devbin install. The arms beside them, on a one-file repository, passed, and so did the fullcycle header and referent arms, whose fixtures also commit an install.

It is a race. The same image (ubuntu-24.04 20261012.334.1) and the same git (2.55.0) passed these arms in run 40283937303 on 04f6368d earlier the same morning, and in runs 40223272158, 40121933255, 40029594494 and 39063036681 back to 2026-10-17. Nothing devbin ships changed between 04f6368d and c4f52b8e. What makes git 2.55.0's maintenance repack this fixture is not reproduced: under git 2.54.0 and 2.56.0, with no global or system config (as the suite runs), the fixture's commit repacks nothing, detached or in the foreground (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/ci/maint-exp2.out). The cause rests on elimination.

A survey of tests/ for any other check of what was written under a fixture found one, surfaces.bats's nothing-written check, and the project it scans is not a git repository.

## Fix

Every fixture commit in tests/unit/readonlygit.bats passes `-c maintenance.auto=false -c gc.auto=0` on the commit itself, so the commit starts no background maintenance. The settings go on the fixture's commits only, never into the fixture repository's config or the suite's environment. devbin's own git calls therefore still run under git's defaults, and anything they start is still measured. Test-only: no shipped file changes.

## Done when

1. Under GIT_TRACE, a fixture commit made as the file now makes it starts no `git maintenance run`, where on main it starts one.
2. readonlygit.bats passes under BSD and GNU.
3. CI's run on the pushed head is green on Test on Ubuntu.

## Resolution

Fixed at 4c4c890d, which changes tests/unit/readonlygit.bats alone, so no shipped file changes. cc built it in a scratch clone (860436b0 on a1ca020c), and vc landed it. commit_fixture now makes every fixture commit in the file, in mkrepo, gitproj, refproj, the fullcycle arm and the GIT_DIR arms, with the fixture's identity and `-c maintenance.auto=false -c gc.auto=0` on the commit alone, so the commit starts no `git maintenance run --auto --detach` that could repack after stale() has backdated .git. Nothing goes into the fixture repository's config or the suite's environment, so devbin's own git calls still run under git's defaults and anything they start is still measured.

- **Done when 1.** readonlygit.bats alone under BSD, with GIT_TRACE written to a file outside every fixture's TMPDIR, on main (a1ca020c) and at the fix. On main, every fixture commit started `git maintenance run --auto --quiet --detach`. At the fix, the same fixture commits were traced and no line of the trace names maintenance, so no git command in the run, the fixture's commits or devbin's own calls, started one. On this Mac (git 2.56.0) main's maintenance runs repacked nothing, as the issue found, so main passed here too; the red on main is CI run 40291928610.
- **Done when 2.** readonlygit.bats alone at the fix, under BSD (the traced run above) and under GNU: each TAP ran to its plan, and nothing failed or skipped. These runs and main's traced run went one at a time under molt-vc's standing GO for light runs, relayed by vc, and the driver ended at 2026-10-26 09:22Z with rc 0. Critic leg: `intent critic shell --files tests/unit/readonlygit.bats` from the clone's root, rc 0; it asked no rule of the file, so it says nothing about it.
- **Done when 3.** CI run 40349359447 on a81f0f98: green on Test on Ubuntu.
